sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 回想当年我在黑胶唱片时代在夜店当DJ时，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带300件你最珍爱的传家宝去工作，你把一个DJ台变成了一个充满美丽50年历史文物的流动快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在即可在您喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重构者》。

sentences.en: Hey everyone, it's Rachel.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是蕾切尔。

sentences.en: We're doing something a little different today.
sentences.zh: 我们今天要聊点不一样的内容。

sentences.en: We're going to take a pause this week from the culture specials that we've been sharing on Sundays,
sentences.zh: 本周我们将在周日分享的文化特辑中暂停一下，

sentences.en: because today we wanted to share the first episode of a new series from our colleagues over at Serial.
sentences.zh: 因为今天我们想要分享来自我们《连环》同事们的新系列节目的第一集。

sentences.en: It's called The PreventioniSt. Like so many of their shows, it's a remarkable story.
sentences.zh: 它叫做《预防者》。和他们的许多节目一样，这是一个非凡的故事。

sentences.en: This one is about a bunch of things, including families navigating surprising and enormous challenges,
sentences.zh: 这个故事涉及很多方面，包括努力应对意想不到的巨大挑战的家庭，

sentences.en: and a public official who's trying to do the right thing in a very complicated situation.
sentences.zh: 以及一位在极其复杂的情况下试图做正确事情的公职人员。

sentences.en: It's really good.
sentences.zh: 这真的很棒。

sentences.en: The episode we're sharing today is the first of a three-part series, which you can find by searching The Preventionist wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 我们今天分享的这一集是一个三部分系列的第一集，您可以在任何收听播客的地方搜索《预防者》来找到它。

sentences.en: And, take note, the whole series is available for free for a limited time.
sentences.zh: 并且请注意，整个系列在限时内免费提供。

sentences.en: So binge away.
sentences.zh: 所以尽情狂欢吧。

sentences.en: Okay, so the Sunday special team will be back with the show next week, and here is the first episode of The PreventioniSt.
sentences.zh: 好了，周日特辑团队下周将携节目回归，以下是《预防者》的第一集。

sentences.en: One evening in August of 2023, I watched a woman step up to the mic during a meeting of local government officials in Allentown, Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 2023年8月的一个晚上，我看着一位女性走上宾夕法尼亚州阿伦敦当地政府官员会议的麦克风前。

sentences.en: She was young, early 20s, strikingly pretty, wearing a pale pink blazer.
sentences.zh: 她很年轻，20岁出头，极其漂亮，穿着一件浅粉色的西装外套。

sentences.en: She's short, five-foot nothing, so she had to stand on her tiptoes to reach the microphone.
sentences.zh: 她个子很矮，还不到五英尺，所以她不得不踮起脚尖才能够到麦克风。

sentences.en: She had five minutes to convey, basically, any parent's nightmare.
sentences.zh: 她有五分钟的时间来讲述基本上是任何父母的噩梦。

sentences.en: My two-month-old son was happily drinking milk from his bottle when he quickly started choking, turned blue, and went limp.
sentences.zh: 我两个月大的儿子正开心地用奶瓶喝着奶，突然开始呛奶，脸色发青，浑身瘫软。

sentences.en: My boyfriend transported our son to the changing table as I grabbed an anti-choking device and my boyfriend began assembling it.
sentences.zh: 我男朋友把我们的儿子抱到尿布台上，我抓起一个防窒息设备，我男朋友开始组装它。

sentences.en: I never ran so fast up the stairs, screaming at the top of my lungs for help.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有跑得这么快过，拼命跑上楼梯，声嘶力竭地大声呼救。

sentences.en: She described the panic in the house, a baby, not breathing.
sentences.zh: 她描述了屋里的恐慌，一个婴儿，无法呼吸。

sentences.en: She and her boyfriend, the father of the child, lived with her parents.
sentences.zh: 她和她的男友，即孩子的父亲，和她的父母住在一起。

sentences.en: Everyone was home when the baby started choking.
sentences.zh: 当婴儿开始呛奶时，家里所有人都醒着。

sentences.en: My father rushed downstairs and immediately started doing chest compressions as I dialed 911.
sentences.zh: 我父亲冲下楼，立即开始做胸外按压，而我拨打了911。

sentences.en: Two pumps of the device and my son was conscious, gasping for air and coughing up milk.
sentences.zh: 设备按了两下，我儿子恢复了意识，大口喘着粗气并咳出了奶。

sentences.en: It worked.
sentences.zh: 成功了。

sentences.en: Thank God, they thought.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，他们想。

sentences.en: They were relieved, but rattled.
sentences.zh: 他们松了一口气，但惊魂未定。

sentences.en: They wanted to make sure the baby was okay, so they sent him to the ER.
sentences.zh: 他们想确保孩子没事，于是把他送去了急诊室。

sentences.en: We saved his life that night.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上我们救了他的命。

sentences.en: But upon arriving at Lehigh Valley Hospital, the diagnosis quickly became something so different, something nobody could have ever prepared me for.
sentences.zh: 但一到达里海山谷医院，诊断结果迅速变成了一种完全不同的情况，一种任何人都不可能为我做好准备的情况。

sentences.en: A lot can be said in five minutes, it turns out, and she still had four to go.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，五分钟内可以讲很多事情，而她还有四分钟。

sentences.en: She described how the whole family went to the hospital, she and her boyfriend, her parents, later his parents too.
sentences.zh: 她描述了全家人是如何去医院的，她和男友、她的父母，后来还有他的父母。

sentences.en: But after their baby was examined, she and her boyfriend were asked to leave, because it turned out one of the doctors had a theory.
sentences.zh: 但经过对他们的婴儿进行检查后，她和男友被要求离开，因为事实证明其中一位医生有一个理论。

sentences.en: She stated to my father and mother-in-law that we are young first-time parents who got frustrated with our baby and violently shook him to make him stop crying,
sentences.zh: 她对我的父亲和岳母声称，我们是年轻的头胎父母，对我们的婴儿感到沮丧，并剧烈摇晃他以让他停止哭泣，

sentences.en: and a confession would only make things easier for us.
sentences.zh: 而坦白只会让我们事情变得容易些。

sentences.en: Their story about the milk and choking and the life-saving device, the hospital was saying, that's a lie,
sentences.zh: 他们关于奶、呛奶和救命设备的说法，医院说，那是谎言，

sentences.en: and that these young parents should just admit that they'd lost their patience and shaken the baby hard.
sentences.zh: 而且这些年轻父母应该承认他们失去了耐心并用力摇晃了婴儿。

sentences.en: They were told to leave the hospital without their baby, and he wouldn't come home for seven whole months.
sentences.zh: 他们被告知在没有孩子的情况下离开医院，而他整整七个月没有回家。

sentences.en: I'm a 21-year-old mother who lost seven months with her firstborn son.
sentences.zh: 我是一位21岁的母亲，失去了与长子相处的七个月时间。

sentences.en: I'm a nursing mother who lost her milk because she wasn't allowed to feed her baby.
sentences.zh: 我是一位哺乳期的母亲，因为不被允许喂养我的婴儿而失去了母乳。

sentences.en: I'm a first-time mom who watched her first child meet milestones over FaceTime.
sentences.zh: 我是一位头胎妈妈，通过FaceTime看着我的第一个孩子达成人生里程碑。

sentences.en: I'm a postpartum mom dealing with the grief and the trauma of my son being ripped from my arMs.
sentences.zh: 我是一位产后妈妈，正在应对我的儿子被从我怀里夺走的悲痛和创伤。

sentences.en: I'm a concerned mother in a hospital looking for help, but instead, we were treated like criminals.
sentences.zh: 我是一位在医院寻求帮助的担忧母亲，但相反，我们被当作罪犯对待。

sentences.en: And I'm a mom who lost everything in less than 24 hours due to one doctor's misdiagnosis.
sentences.zh: 我是一位在不到24小时内因一位医生的误诊而失去了一切的妈妈。

sentences.en: Enough is enough.
sentences.zh: 够了，真的够了。

sentences.en: This wasn't my first time hearing a story like this.
sentences.zh: 这并不是我第一次听到这样的故事。

sentences.en: I've been reporting for a few years on the child welfare system, and I've written about similar situations.
sentences.zh: 我报道儿童福利系统已经好几年了，我写过类似的情况。

sentences.en: Parents who say they were falsely accused of abuse, that their kids were taken from them without cause.
sentences.zh: 父母说他们被虚假指控虐待，他们的孩子在没有理由的情况下被带走。

sentences.en: In 2023, I got a series of emails from people in the Lehigh Valley, a part of eastern Pennsylvania, north of Philadelphia, where small towns bleed into rural pastures.
sentences.zh: 2023年，我收到了一系列来自里海山谷人们的电子邮件，这里是宾夕法尼亚州东部的一部分，在费城以北，小镇与乡村牧场交融。

sentences.en: I got phone calls from people there, too.
sentences.zh: 我也接到了那里人们的电话。

sentences.en: One person said,
sentences.zh: 一个人说：

sentences.en: Essentially, if you think that last story you wrote was bad, you won't believe what's happening in the Lehigh Valley.
sentences.zh: 基本上，如果你认为你写上一篇故事很糟糕，你简直不会相信里海山谷正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: So I started looking into it, which is how I ended up at this public meeting, hearing about a baby who choked on milk and was taken away from his parents for most of his infancy.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始调查此事，这就是为什么我最终来到了这个公开会议，听说了关于一个因呛奶而差点窒息并在大部分婴儿时期被从父母身边带走的婴儿的故事。

sentences.en: And now, after two years of talking to families and medical personnel and caseworkers, I can tell you that caller was right.
sentences.zh: 现在，在与家庭、医务人员和个案工作者交谈了两年之后，我可以告诉你那个打电话的人是对的。

sentences.en: Whatever was happening in the Lehigh Valley, it was not normal.
sentences.zh: 无论里海山谷发生了什么，这都不正常。

sentences.en: I'm Diane Neary, and from Serial Productions and The New York Times, this is The PreventioniSt.
sentences.zh: 我是戴安·内里，来自连环制作公司和《纽约时报》，这是《预防者》。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning, and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空中的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星之外是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today, I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天，我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都使用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一个平底锅就能做好的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮助您理解世界并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即在 nytimes.com slash subscribe 订阅以获得优惠。

sentences.en: I want to explain how this extraordinary situation in the Lehigh Valley came to light in the first place.
sentences.zh: 我想解释一下里海山谷这种非凡的情况是如何最初曝光的。

sentences.en: Because it almost didn't.
sentences.zh: 因为差一点就没有曝光。

sentences.en: Except that this one guy would not let it go.
sentences.zh: 除了这个人就是不肯罢休。

sentences.en: His name is Mark Pinsley.
sentences.zh: 他的名字叫马克·平斯利。

sentences.en: And he's not an activist or a medical expert or an aggrieved parent.
sentences.zh: 他既不是活动人士，也不是医学专家，更不是心怀不满的父母。

sentences.en: He's a controller.
sentences.zh: 他是一名主计长。

sentences.en: A money guy.
sentences.zh: 一个管钱的人。

sentences.en: I barely knew what a controller was until I met Mark.
sentences.zh: 在遇到马克之前，我几乎不知道主计长是什么。

sentences.en: Mark barely knew what that was before he became one.
sentences.zh: 马克在成为主计长之前也几乎不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: He'd run for state senate on the Democratic ticket in Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 他曾代表民主党在宾夕法尼亚州竞选州参议员。

sentences.en: And loSt.
sentences.zh: 并且输了。

sentences.en: And when I came off that loss, the party came to me again and said, hey, would you like to be controller of Lehigh County?
sentences.zh: 当我从那次失败中走出来时，党派再次找到我，说，嘿，你想当里海县的主计长吗？

sentences.en: And I was like, what is controller of Lehigh County?
sentences.zh: 我当时就想，里海县的主计长是什么？

sentences.en: So I really had no idea.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的完全不知道。

sentences.en: Mark learned a controller is in charge of auditing the county's finances, making sure there's no fraud, no waste of taxpayer money.
sentences.zh: 马克了解到主计长负责审计县里的财务，确保没有欺诈，没有浪费纳税人的钱。

sentences.en: Mark had studied finance, and he managed budgets for both big and small companies.
sentences.zh: 马克学过金融，他曾为大公司和小公司管理过预算。

sentences.en: He still owns a small skincare business.
sentences.zh: 他仍然拥有一家小型护肤品公司。

sentences.en: It seemed like a good fit.
sentences.zh: 这看起来很合适。

sentences.en: So that's what I did.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我所做的。

sentences.en: I ran and I won controller.
sentences.zh: 我参选并赢得了主计长职位。

sentences.en: And my goal was to figure out how I could help the people using that position and being creative around financing.
sentences.zh: 我的目标是弄清楚如何利用这个职位帮助人们，并在融资方面发挥创意。

sentences.en: Mark's an ambitious guy.
sentences.zh: 马克是一个有雄心的人。

sentences.en: He wanted to use his skills to do more than just audit the county's payroll.
sentences.zh: 他想利用自己的技能做更多事情，而不仅仅是审计县里的工资单。

sentences.en: And he was good at it.
sentences.zh: 而且他很擅长。

sentences.en: In his first few years, he investigated a big pharmaceutical company that was overcharging for prescription drugs.
sentences.zh: 在他上任的头几年里，他调查了一家对处方药过度收费的大型制药公司。

sentences.en: And he discovered a county nursing home had failed to collect hundreds of thousands of dollars.
sentences.zh: 他发现一家县立疗养院未能收取数十万美元的费用。

sentences.en: His audits have saved the county and its taxpayers millions.
sentences.zh: 他的审计为该县及其纳税人节省了数百万美元。

sentences.en: To hear Mark tell it, the idea for his next big project kind of came out of left field.
sentences.zh: 听马克叙述，他下一个大项目的想法有点出乎意料。

sentences.en: One day, he and his wife were out grocery shopping.
sentences.zh: 有一天，他和妻子出去买杂货。

sentences.en: I hate waiting in lines.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌排队。

sentences.en: And my wife was in where we were in line to, you know, pay for groceries.
sentences.zh: 我妻子当时在我们要排队去，你知道的，付杂货费的地方。

sentences.en: And I'm like, I'm just gonna go watch TikTok.
sentences.zh: 我就想，我要去看TikTok。

sentences.en: And so I was watching TikTok, you know, just kind of wasting time scrolling away.
sentences.zh: 所以我当时在看TikTok，你知道的，就是无聊地刷着消磨时间。

sentences.en: And a video came up.
sentences.zh: 然后弹出了一个视频。

sentences.en: Your favorite author here speaking to tell you about a complete win a week ago.
sentences.zh: 你最喜欢的作家在这里发言，告诉你一周前的一次完全胜利。

sentences.en: Mark almost swiped away because, for one, his favorite author is Stephen King.
sentences.zh: 马克差点划走，因为一方面，他最喜欢的作家是斯蒂芬·金。

sentences.en: And this woman, he didn't even know who she was.
sentences.zh: 而这个女人，他甚至不知道她是谁。

sentences.en: But he lingered.
sentences.zh: 但他留下来了。

sentences.en: And then she said Allentown.
sentences.zh: 然后她说出了阿伦敦。

sentences.en: And like, so then I paid attention.
sentences.zh: 所以接下来我就开始注意了。

sentences.en: And then she said Children and Youth, and I was paying more attention.
sentences.zh: 然后她说了儿童与青年，我就更加关注了。

sentences.en: Allentown is in Lehigh County.
sentences.zh: 阿伦敦在里海县。

sentences.en: And the Office of Children and Youth Services is a county agency.
sentences.zh: 而儿童与青年服务办公室是一个县级机构。

sentences.en: In other words, Mark's territory.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，是马克的管辖范围。

sentences.en: And the woman talking in the video was not only an author.
sentences.zh: 视频里说话的那个女人不仅是一位作家。

sentences.en: She was a lawyer who'd represented a couple in a year-long fight against the false accusation made by a local hospital of child abuse.
sentences.zh: 她还是一位律师，曾代表一对夫妇进行了一年之久的抗争，对抗当地医院关于虐待儿童的虚假指控。

sentences.en: They'd won.
sentences.zh: 他们赢了。

sentences.en: The county had withdrawn its petition to remove the couple's child.
sentences.zh: 该县撤回了撤除这对夫妇孩子的呈请。

sentences.en: Mark wondered.
sentences.zh: 马克感到好奇。

sentences.en: If the county was wasting time on losing fights, it might also be wasting money in the process.
sentences.zh: 如果该县在必输的争斗上浪费时间，它可能在此过程中也在浪费金钱。

sentences.en: I'm like, eh, there might be money there.
sentences.zh: 我心想，呃，那里可能涉及资金。

sentences.en: Let me go find out.
sentences.zh: 让我去查明真相。

sentences.en: And so, like, I immediately emailed right away.
sentences.zh: 所以，就像这样，我立刻发了电子邮件。

sentences.en: He wrote to the couple mentioned in the TikTok, saying he wanted to understand more about what had happened.
sentences.zh: 他写信给TikTok中提到的那对夫妇，称他想更多地了解发生了什么。

sentences.en: He wrote, quote,
sentences.zh: 他写道，引述：

sentences.en: To be upfront, I have always had a good feeling about the people that work for Children and Youth.
sentences.zh: 坦白说，我对在儿童与青年部门工作的人一直有很好的感觉。

sentences.en: I have felt that they were overworked and underpaid, end quote.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们工作过劳且薪酬过低，引述结束。

sentences.en: But he said, If you're willing to share more, I am willing to listen.
sentences.zh: 但他说，如果你愿意分享更多，我愿意倾听。

sentences.en: Thank you for your time, Mark.
sentences.zh: 感谢您的时间，马克。

sentences.en: And then, by the time I was done emailing, I helped starting to unload the groceries.
sentences.zh: 然后，当我发完电子邮件时，我开始帮忙卸杂货。

sentences.en: Within 24 hours, the couple wrote back.
sentences.zh: 在24小时内，这对夫妇回了信。

sentences.en: Mark set up his conference room for a video call with the mother and the lawyer.
sentences.zh: 马克布置好他的会议室，与这位母亲和律师进行视频通话。

sentences.en: And on his screen, he saw their faces pop up.
sentences.zh: 在屏幕上，他看到他们的脸弹了出来。

sentences.en: They walked me through, like, the basics.
sentences.zh: 他们向我介绍了，像是，基础情况。

sentences.en: I mean, it was more than just the basics, but, you know, it was an hour-and-a-half phone call.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这不仅仅是基础情况，但是，你知道的，这是一通一个半小时的电话。

sentences.en: The mom did most of the speaking.
sentences.zh: 这位妈妈说得最多。

sentences.en: She told Mark about how both her boys had complex medical needs.
sentences.zh: 她告诉马克，她的两个男孩都有复杂的医疗需求。

sentences.en: One had autism and an autoimmune disorder.
sentences.zh: 一个患有自闭症和自身免疫性疾病。

sentences.en: The other had autism and a metabolic disorder.
sentences.zh: 另一个患有自闭症和代谢紊乱。

sentences.en: She said she and her husband had spent years working hard to find their boys the right therapists and treatments, medicines and vitamins and supplements, to get them stable.
sentences.zh: 她说她和丈夫花了好几年时间努力为他们的男孩寻找合适的治疗师和疗法、药物、维生素和补充剂，以使他们病情稳定。

sentences.en: And by her account, they mostly succeeded.
sentences.zh: 据她所说，他们大多成功了。

sentences.en: But then one day, one of their boys started to behave erratically.
sentences.zh: 但有一天，他们的一个男孩开始出现反常行为。

sentences.en: They took him to the Lehigh Valley Children's Hospital in Allentown, where the mom said a doctor puzzled over the case and what seemed like too many interventions for the boys.
sentences.zh: 他们把他带到了阿伦敦的里海山谷儿童医院，在那里这位妈妈说一位医生对这个病例以及对男孩们似乎太多的干预措施感到困惑。

sentences.en: She said that without ever meeting with her or her husband, the doctor diagnosed Munchausen Syndrome by proxy,
sentences.zh: 她说，在从未与她或她丈夫见面过的情况下，这位医生诊断为代理性孟乔森综合征，

sentences.en: a psychological disorder in which a parent fakes their child's illnesses for attention, or even intentionally hurts them, and then seeks treatment for those injuries.
sentences.zh: 这是一种心理疾病，父母为了引起注意而伪造孩子的疾病，甚至故意伤害他们，然后寻求对这些伤害的治疗。

sentences.en: It's a popular storyline in movies, but in reality, it's a rare condition.
sentences.zh: 这是电影中的热门情节，但在现实中，这是一种罕见的疾病。

sentences.en: In this case, the mom said both she and her husband were accused of having it, and both of them were barred from seeing their son.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，这位母亲说她和她的丈夫都被指控患有此病，并且两人都被禁止探望他们的儿子。

sentences.en: The hospital declined my interview requests for this series, but in an email, a representative wrote,
sentences.zh: 这家医院拒绝了我为这个系列节目进行的采访请求，但在一封电子邮件中，一位代表写道：

sentences.en: In the video call, the mother and her lawyer explained to Mark that the child abuse accusation progressed quickly,
sentences.zh: 在视频通话中，这位母亲和她的律师向马克解释说，虐待儿童的指控进展迅速，

sentences.en: from the hospital, to an investigation by children and youth, to family court.
sentences.zh: 从医院到儿童及青年服务机构的调查，再到家庭法院。

sentences.en: The parents lost custody of their younger son for a month, their older son for a year.
sentences.zh: 这对父母失去了他们小儿子一个月的监护权，大儿子则是一年。

sentences.en: And so it was a very emotional story.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个非常触动人心的故事。

sentences.en: Like, you can't come away as a parent and be like,
sentences.zh: 作为一个父母，你不可能看完之后觉得，

sentences.en: Well, hey, that was, that was, that was, who cares?
sentences.zh: 好吧，嘿，那，那，那，谁在乎呢？

sentences.en: At first, I just thought that, like, this is two unfortunate souls, so the husband and the wife got caught up in something,
sentences.zh: 起初，我只是觉得，这就像是两个倒霉的灵魂，丈夫和妻子卷入了某种麻烦中，

sentences.en: and then I started looking in, and it just became very quickly apparent that there was a problem.
sentences.zh: 然后我开始深入调查，很快就明显看出这里面有问题。

sentences.en: Very quickly.
sentences.zh: 非常快。

sentences.en: This family knew of other families, whom they put in touch with Mark.
sentences.zh: 这个家庭还知道其他家庭，并将他们介绍给了马克。

sentences.en: He made a spreadsheet, assigning each family a color so he could keep track.
sentences.zh: 他制作了一个电子表格，给每个家庭分配一种颜色，以便追踪记录。

sentences.en: The green family, the blue family.
sentences.zh: 绿色家庭，蓝色家庭。

sentences.en: The couple he just talked to were the gray family.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚交谈过的那对夫妇是灰色家庭。

sentences.en: He knew he couldn't take their stories at face value, so he started fact-checking them, which he hated.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己不能盲目相信他们的故事，于是开始核实事实，尽管他对此深恶痛绝。

sentences.en: It was awkward to ask people for proof, documentation, but they produced it.
sentences.zh: 向人们索要证据和文件是件很尴尬的事，但他们确实拿出来了。

sentences.en: And then he had to read that documentation, medical paperwork, and child welfare reports, hundreds of pages.
sentences.zh: 然后他不得不阅读这些文件，包括医疗文书和儿童福利报告，足足有几百页。

sentences.en: And I was a neophyte about this when I started, too, right?
sentences.zh: 我刚开始接触这行时也是个新手，对吧？

sentences.en: So, like, I didn't know what certain terms meant.
sentences.zh: 所以，有些专业术语我并不懂是什么意思。

sentences.en: And so, in the beginning, I'm, like, writing down the terms, like, so that I would remember them.
sentences.zh: 因此，在一开始，我会把这些术语写下来，好让自己记住它们。

sentences.en: And so, many times, I would have to go back later and reread a section, and it had a whole new meaning to me.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，我后来不得不回头重新阅读某一部分，它对我来说便有了全新的含义。

sentences.en: He searched Google, got some help from someone on his staff.
sentences.zh: 他在谷歌上搜索，并得到了他团队中某人的帮助。

sentences.en: He began to decipher the system.
sentences.zh: 他开始破解这个系统。

sentences.en: He learned that in Lehigh County, if a parent is suspected of child abuse, in this case, suspected by a doctor at the hospital, that doctor calls the state child abuse hotline.
sentences.zh: 他了解到，在利哈伊县，如果怀疑父母虐待儿童——在本案中，是医院的医生这样怀疑——这位医生就会拨打州虐待儿童热线。

sentences.en: An operator there takes down the report and sends it to Children and Youth Services, known as CYS.
sentences.zh: 那里的接线员记录下报告，并将其发送给儿童及青年服务局，简称CYS。

sentences.en: And then CYS has two months to make a determination.
sentences.zh: 然后CYS有两个月的时间做出裁决。

sentences.en: You have 60 days as a caseworker to decide whether something is unfounded, meaning we really don't suspect child abuse at all,
sentences.zh: 作为一名个案工作者，你有60天的时间来决定某件事是无根据的，意思是我们真的不怀疑存在虐待儿童的情况，

sentences.en: indicated, which is supposed to mean that there's a lot of evidence that kind of makes it suspicious that you might well be a child abuser.
sentences.zh: 或是被确证的（indicated），这本意是指有大量证据让人怀疑你很有可能是一个虐待儿童的人。

sentences.en: Or a third category, founded, meaning that both CYS and a court have found that you're an abuser.
sentences.zh: 或者是第三类，即已查实的（founded），意思是CYS和法院都认定你是一个虐待者。

sentences.en: There was one more term Mark had never heard before, which kept popping up in the paperwork.
sentences.zh: 还有一个马克以前从未听过的词，在文件中频频出现。

sentences.en: Child abuse pediatrician.
sentences.zh: 虐待儿童儿科医生。

sentences.en: Mark realized almost all of the allegations in the family's files have been made by this kind of doctor.
sentences.zh: 马克意识到，该家庭档案中几乎所有的指控都是由这种医生提出的。

sentences.en: A child abuse pediatrician.
sentences.zh: 一名虐待儿童儿科医生。

sentences.en: CAP, for short.
sentences.zh: 简称CAP。

sentences.en: More Googling, and Mark learned this.
sentences.zh: 通过更多的谷歌搜索，马克了解到了这一点。

sentences.en: CAPs are doctors who are trained specifically in how to tell whether an injury is the result of abuse.
sentences.zh: CAP是专门受过培训的医生，知道如何辨别伤势是否是虐待造成的。

sentences.en: To tell the difference, say, between an arm broken by falling off the swing set versus an arm broken after being twisted by force.
sentences.zh: 例如，分辨是从秋千上摔下来骨折的手臂，还是被外力扭断的手臂。

sentences.en: They often work in children's hospitals, including Lehigh Valley's Children's Hospital.
sentences.zh: 他们通常在儿童医院工作，包括利哈伊谷儿童医院。

sentences.en: And they play a crucial role in keeping children safe.
sentences.zh: 他们在保障儿童安全方面发挥着至关重要的作用。

sentences.en: According to the most recent government data, every year, more than 3 million children in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 根据政府最新的数据，在美国，每年有超过300万名儿童

sentences.en: are victims of suspected abuse.
sentences.zh: 是疑似虐待的受害者。

sentences.en: CAPs help figure out which of those children need protecting.
sentences.zh: CAP帮助确定这些儿童中哪些需要保护。

sentences.en: The stakes are obviously high.
sentences.zh: 很显然，这事关重大。

sentences.en: In 2023, about 2,000 children died from abuse or neglect.
sentences.zh: 2023年，大约有2000名儿童死于虐待或疏忽。

sentences.en: Mark was noticing, reading the family's files, how much influence a CAP's opinion carried, which made sense to Mark.
sentences.zh: 马克在阅读这些家庭的档案时注意到，CAP的意见具有多么大的影响力，这在马克看来是合情合理的。

sentences.en: After all, the CAPs are the medically trained experts.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，CAP是受过医学专业培训的专家。

sentences.en: But then again, what happened if the CAP got it wrong?
sentences.zh: 话又说回来，如果CAP搞错了会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: In the case histories he was reading, there were examples of that happening.
sentences.zh: 在他阅读的案例历史中，确实有这种情况发生的例子。

sentences.en: The file he'd labeled the Yellow Family, for instance.
sentences.zh: 比如他标记为“黄色家庭”的档案。

sentences.en: This mom had talked to me about, like, and she was a nurse.
sentences.zh: 这位母亲曾跟我谈过，而且她是一名护士。

sentences.en: So she had talked to me about this case where
sentences.zh: 所以她曾跟我谈起这样一个案子，

sentences.en: her husband called her and said that the child wasn't able to sit up.
sentences.zh: 她的丈夫打电话给她，说孩子坐不起来了。

sentences.en: This was a kid who could normally sit up.
sentences.zh: 这本来是一个平时能坐起来的孩子。

sentences.en: He was 18 months old, and the husband said he had fallen off the couch while playing with his siblings.
sentences.zh: 他当时18个月大，丈夫说他在跟兄弟姐妹玩耍时从沙发上摔了下来。

sentences.en: The next morning, he seemed hurt and couldn't sit up without falling backwards.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，他看起来受了伤，坐着时会向后倒，无法自己坐稳。

sentences.en: So she calls her pediatrician.
sentences.zh: 于是她给儿科医生打电话。

sentences.en: The pediatrician says, you know, take them to the hospital.
sentences.zh: 儿科医生说，你知道的，带他们去医院吧。

sentences.en: And in this particular instance, like, there was a fracture of the ribs.
sentences.zh: 在这个特定的例子中，有肋骨骨折的情况。

sentences.en: I think it was two fractures of the ribs that were healing.
sentences.zh: 我想当时有两处正在愈合的肋骨骨折。

sentences.en: Further testing revealed the child had a total of four broken ribs in various stages of healing.
sentences.zh: 进一步的检查显示，该儿童共有四处处于不同愈合阶段的断肋。

sentences.en: As in, fractures that could not have all happened that day by, say, falling off the couch.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，这些骨折不可能全是在那一天通过诸如从沙发上摔下来之类的方式造成的。

sentences.en: The story the parents had told didn't match the injuries doctors were seeing.
sentences.zh: 父母讲述的故事与医生看到的伤情不符。

sentences.en: So this one was a harder one for me because the child had broken bones.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说这个案子更难处理，因为孩子确实有骨折。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: And you're like, okay, well, like, this one seems a little off.
sentences.zh: 然后你会想，好吧，这个案子好像有点不对劲。

sentences.en: The doctor, a cap, was suspicious of the father.
sentences.zh: 这位医生，也就是CAP，对父亲产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: Fractures at various stages of healing could point toward a pattern of injury.
sentences.zh: 处于不同愈合阶段的骨折可能指向一种受伤模式。

sentences.en: And the father was the one who claimed the child had fallen.
sentences.zh: 而且声称孩子摔倒的人正是父亲。

sentences.en: And the mom was just like, she was adamant.
sentences.zh: 而母亲则态度坚决。

sentences.en: Like, the father didn't do this.
sentences.zh: 就好像，父亲绝对没有这样做。

sentences.en: You know, like, there's no way, you know, it took us a long time to get pregnant, all that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，绝无可能，你知道的，我们怀上这个孩子花了很长时间，诸如此类的话。

sentences.en: The mom was a nurse and she started her own research.
sentences.zh: 这位母亲是一名护士，她开始自己进行调查。

sentences.en: What else could explain the injuries?
sentences.zh: 还有什么能解释这些伤情？

sentences.en: A genetic condition, maybe?
sentences.zh: 也许是某种遗传疾病？

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the cap in this case was firm in her finding of abuse.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，本案中的CAP坚信存在虐待行为。

sentences.en: According to the mom, the doctor even suggested the unthinkable.
sentences.zh: 据母亲说，这位医生甚至提出了令人难以置信的建议。

sentences.en: That she leave her husband, take the children, and, quote, never look back.
sentences.zh: 让她离开丈夫，带着孩子，“永远不要回头”。

sentences.en: The mom said CYS, quote, badgered her to file for divorce in order to keep her children.
sentences.zh: 母亲说CYS“纠缠”她去起诉离婚，以此作为保留孩子抚养权的条件。

sentences.en: And eventually,
sentences.zh: 最终，

sentences.en: She actually got a divorce.
sentences.zh: 她真的离婚了。

sentences.en: And I would have done the same thing, right?
sentences.zh: 换作我也会这么做，对吧？

sentences.en: Even though, like, my gut instinct is like,
sentences.zh: 尽管我的直觉是，

sentences.en: I'm not going to let this happen.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会让这种事发生。

sentences.en: Well, there's no way I'm going to let this happen to my kid.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我绝不会让这种事发生在我的孩子身上。

sentences.en: And the mother was like, no.
sentences.zh: 而这位母亲则态度坚决地认为，不。

sentences.en: Like, I just don't believe it.
sentences.zh: 我就是不相信。

sentences.en: I believe there's, like, something genetic going on.
sentences.zh: 我相信有什么遗传方面的原因在起作用。

sentences.en: I believe this.
sentences.zh: 我相信这一点。

sentences.en: The husband, or the former husband now, she divorces him, right, goes to jail.
sentences.zh: 丈夫，或者说现在的前夫，她跟他离了婚，对吧，然后进了监狱。

sentences.en: And in the meantime, the mother keeps working.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，这位母亲继续工作。

sentences.en: She can't get a genetic test for whatever it was, two and a half months.
sentences.zh: 在长达两个半月的时间里，她都无法进行基因检测。

sentences.en: When she finally did get a genetic test at a different hospital, a diagnosis came back.
sentences.zh: 当她终于在另一家医院做基因检测时，诊断结果出来了。

sentences.en: Type 1 osteogenesis imperfecta.
sentences.zh: 1型成骨不全症。

sentences.en: And wouldn't you believe it, the child has brittle bone disease.
sentences.zh: 你敢信吗，这个孩子患有脆骨病。

sentences.en: That same day, her now ex-husband was released from jail.
sentences.zh: 就在同一天，她现任的前夫被释放出狱。

sentences.en: And one month later, all the criminal charges against him were dropped.
sentences.zh: 一个月后，针对他的所有刑事指控都被撤销了。

sentences.en: Like, I can't stand it.
sentences.zh: 简直让人无法忍受。

sentences.en: Mark had interviewed more than a dozen families by this point.
sentences.zh: 到这个时候，马克已经采访了十几个家庭。

sentences.en: And he'd reached his limit.
sentences.zh: 他已经达到了忍耐的极限。

sentences.en: Like, I can't live knowing that America is like that or that Pennsylvania is like that.
sentences.zh: 我简直无法忍受这样的现实：美国是这样的，或者宾夕法尼亚州是这样的。

sentences.en: Like, I have to do something about it.
sentences.zh: 我必须为此做点什么。

sentences.en: A reminder,
sentences.zh: 提醒一下，

sentences.en: Mark is a controller.
sentences.zh: 马克是一名审计长。

sentences.en: He has zero oversight of child welfare services.
sentences.zh: 他对儿童福利服务没有任何监督权。

sentences.en: He can't intervene in CYS procedures.
sentences.zh: 他无法干预CYS的程序。

sentences.en: He can't dictate hospital policy.
sentences.zh: 他无法对医院的政策发号施令。

sentences.en: But what he can do is look at the money.
sentences.zh: 但他能做的是查看资金流向。

sentences.en: Find out what all this was costing the county.
sentences.zh: 弄清楚这一切让县里付出了多少代价。

sentences.en: And he could make that public.
sentences.zh: 并且他可以将其公之于众。

sentences.en: He could write a report that might put pressure on the people who could change policy at CYS.
sentences.zh: 他可以写一份报告，向那些能够改变CYS政策的人施加压力。

sentences.en: The Lehigh County Board of Commissioners.
sentences.zh: 利哈伊县专员委员会。

sentences.en: Mark started tallying up the costs.
sentences.zh: 马克开始计算各项费用。

sentences.en: Caseworkers, attorneys, judges.
sentences.zh: 个案工作者、律师、法官。

sentences.en: The county pays for their time.
sentences.zh: 县里为他们的工作时间付费。

sentences.en: The county pays for foster care.
sentences.zh: 县里为寄养服务付费。

sentences.en: And from mandated psychological evaluations.
sentences.zh: 还有强制性的心理评估。

sentences.en: When a judge orders parents and kids to do therapy, the county pays for that, too.
sentences.zh: 当法官下令要求父母和孩子进行治疗时，县里也要为此买单。

sentences.en: If the abuse allegation turned out to be wrong, that seemed like financial waste to Mark.
sentences.zh: 如果虐待指控被证明是错误的，在马克看来，这就构成了财政浪费。

sentences.en: He was on a tear now, thinking about these families.
sentences.zh: 一想到这些家庭，他现在情绪激动，停不下来。

sentences.en: I mean, as I learned more stories, I couldn't sleep at night for two reasons.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，随着我了解到更多故事，我有两个原因晚上睡不着觉。

sentences.en: A, I knew that I'm putting them through their trauma again.
sentences.zh: 第一，我知道我正在让他们再次经历创伤。

sentences.en: And B, I actually now believe them.
sentences.zh: 第二，我现在真的相信他们了。

sentences.en: And I'm like, you know, I can't get this report done fast enough.
sentences.zh: 我就觉得，你知道的，我恨不得这份报告能早点写完。

sentences.en: I can't get this report done fast enough.
sentences.zh: 我恨不得这份报告能早点写完。

sentences.en: I am like, now I'm waking up at six o'clock in the morning, starting to write the report.
sentences.zh: 我感觉，我现在早上六点钟醒来就开始写报告。

sentences.en: I'm not going to bed until midnight to get this report out.
sentences.zh: 为了把这份报告赶出来，我直到半夜十二点才上床睡觉。

sentences.en: Apart from the money,
sentences.zh: 除了金钱之外，

sentences.en: Mark also crunched the state's annual data on child abuse allegations.
sentences.zh: 马克还对该州关于虐待儿童指控的年度数据进行了深入分析。

sentences.en: And what he saw when he compared the Lehigh Valley to the rest of the state was striking.
sentences.zh: 当他将利哈伊谷与该州其他地区进行比较时，他所看到的景象令人震惊。

sentences.en: A third of the state's cases of Munchausen by proxy, a third of those diagnoses, in all of Pennsylvania, had come from the Lehigh Valley region.
sentences.zh: 全宾夕法尼亚州三分之一的代理孟乔森综合征（Munchausen by proxy）病例，其中三分之一的诊断都来自利哈伊谷地区。

sentences.en: The numbers were small overall, but still, that high percentage made no sense to him, especially since the region is home to just 3% of the state's under-18 population.
sentences.zh: 总体数字虽然很小，但鉴于该地区的18岁以下人口仅占全州的3%，如此高的比例依然毫无道理。

sentences.en: So something's not right.
sentences.zh: 所以有些地方不对劲。

sentences.en: There is a problem.
sentences.zh: 这里有问题。

sentences.en: I start contacting all of the commissioners.
sentences.zh: 我开始联系所有的专员。

sentences.en: I'm calling each one of them.
sentences.zh: 我给他们每个人打电话。

sentences.en: Like, I really want you to take a listen to this.
sentences.zh: 我就想，我真的很希望你们能听一听这个。

sentences.en: Are you willing to talk to families?
sentences.zh: 你们愿意和这些家庭谈谈吗？

sentences.en: He contacted each of them, repeatedly, trying to set up meetings.
sentences.zh: 他反复联系了他们每个人，试图安排会面。

sentences.en: Most of the commissioners avoided him.
sentences.zh: 大多数专员都避而不见。

sentences.en: Some agreed to talk.
sentences.zh: 有些人同意谈谈。

sentences.en: He said he told them about the crazy high Munchausen stat, and that if Munchausen syndrome was being misdiagnosed, he thought there was certainly cause to investigate that.
sentences.zh: 他说他向他们讲述了高得离谱的孟乔森综合征数据，并认为如果孟乔森综合征被错误诊断，这绝对有理由进行调查。

sentences.en: And all of it, aside from being wrong and damaging to families, could open up the county to lawsuits, since CYS is the agency responsible for removing the kids.
sentences.zh: 而且所有这些——除了是错误的并对家庭造成伤害之外——还可能让该县面临诉讼风险，因为CYS是负责带走孩子的机构。

sentences.en: Mark says some of them were willing to listen, but none was willing to take action.
sentences.zh: 马克说，其中有些人愿意倾听，但没有人愿意采取行动。

sentences.en: He even offered to put them directly in touch with some of the families.
sentences.zh: 他甚至主动提出让他们与其中一些家庭直接取得联系。

sentences.en: They declined.
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝了。

sentences.en: On top of that,
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，

sentences.en: Mark says he contacted the county directors of CYS and the Department of Human Services.
sentences.zh: 马克说他联系了CYS和人类服务部的县主管。

sentences.en: I contacted county officials, including the chair of the commissioners, to hear their version of events.
sentences.zh: 我联系了包括专员主席在内的县官员，以听取他们对事件的看法。

sentences.en: In response, I received an email from the county's attorney, saying that unfortunately, they couldn't discuss any matters involving the Office of Children and Youth
sentences.zh: 作为回应，我收到了县律师的一封电子邮件，称不幸的是，他们无法讨论任何涉及儿童和青年办公室的事宜。

sentences.en: due to legal concerns.
sentences.zh: 由于法律方面的顾虑。

sentences.en: Ditto the county directors of CYS and the Department of Human Services.
sentences.zh: CYS 和人类服务部的县级主管们也是如此。

sentences.en: Mark knew that publishing a report had the potential to tank his career.
sentences.zh: 马克知道，发表报告可能会彻底毁了他的职业生涯。

sentences.en: It was an election year.
sentences.zh: 那是个选举年。

sentences.en: And to voters, it might look like he was being an apologist for child abusers.
sentences.zh: 而且在选民看来，这可能显得他在为虐童者辩护。

sentences.en: Members of his own staff suggested he wait until after the election to release it.
sentences.zh: 他自己团队的成员建议他等选举结束后再发布。

sentences.en: But Mark thought about how he'd feel if he held off and then wasn't re-elected.
sentences.zh: 但马克想到，如果他压下报告却又没能连任，他会有什么感受。

sentences.en: He would have missed his chance to speak up.
sentences.zh: 他就会错过发声的机会。

sentences.en: So he pushed ahead.
sentences.zh: 所以他还是坚持推进。

sentences.en: He gave the county leadership a heads up.
sentences.zh: 他给县领导提前打了招呼。

sentences.en: The report was coming, along with a press conference.
sentences.zh: 报告即将发布，还将召开新闻发布会。

sentences.en: He also gave them advanced notice of his recommendations for changes he hoped they'd make at CYS.
sentences.zh: 他还提前将他对 CYS 改革建议的修改意见告知了他们。

sentences.en: Chiefly, require caseworkers to get a second opinion from a doctor when considering whether to remove a child based on a medical finding.
sentences.zh: 主要是，要求社工在考虑是否根据医学发现带走儿童时，必须征求医生的第二诊疗意见。

sentences.en: And, he wanted them to hire an outside firm to investigate CYS procedures.
sentences.zh: 并且，他希望他们聘请外部机构来调查 CYS 的程序。

sentences.en: Before he published his report,
sentences.zh: 在他发表报告之前，

sentences.en: Mark had a few questions for the solicitors, the county's lawyers.
sentences.zh: 马克向法律顾问（也就是县里的律师）询问了几个问题。

sentences.en: His lawyers, in a way, since he was a county official, too.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说也是他的律师，因为他也是县官员。

sentences.en: He had all these records containing sensitive information about kids' medical issues and family court proceedings.
sentences.zh: 他手里有所有这些记录，包含关于孩子们医疗问题和家庭法庭诉讼的敏感信息。

sentences.en: So, he asked them, what could he legally include in a public-facing report?
sentences.zh: 于是，他问他们，在法律上他可以在面向公众的报告中包含什么内容？

sentences.en: When the response came back, it was short.
sentences.zh: 当回复传来时，内容很短。

sentences.en: Basically two words.
sentences.zh: 基本上就两个字。

sentences.en: C attached.
sentences.zh: 见附件。

sentences.en: So when you say it's a PDF attachment, you know it's going to be long.
sentences.zh: 所以当你听说这是个 PDF 附件时，你就知道它肯定很长。

sentences.en: Mark didn't have a great feeling about this.
sentences.zh: 马克对此有种很不好的预感。

sentences.en: He made a cup of tea, printed the PDF, and settled down to read it.
sentences.zh: 他泡了杯茶，打印出 PDF，坐下来开始阅读。

sentences.en: That's after a break.
sentences.zh: 稍事休息后继续。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《连线》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的益智游戏之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作

sentences.en: Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 《拼字蜜蜂》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的奇特现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到那些声音的人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: The PDF from the solicitors was long.
sentences.zh: 法律顾问发来的 PDF 很长。

sentences.en: It was on county letterhead, and the subtext to Mark at least was clear.
sentences.zh: 那是用县政府的信笺打印的，对马克而言，其潜台词是不言而喻的。

sentences.en: His report was dead on arrival.
sentences.zh: 他的报告还没面世就夭折了。

sentences.en: One of the first lines of it read,
sentences.zh: 其中的第一行写道：

sentences.en: The most significant overarching concern is whether your pursuit of this information for the reasons you have stated goes beyond the scope of your authority as the controller.
sentences.zh: 最重大的全局性关切是，你出于所述理由对这些信息的追查，是否超出了你作为审计长的职权范围。

sentences.en: The concept of...
sentences.zh: 这个概念……

sentences.en: The solicitors were saying, documenting really, that if Mark would have published this report, he might be acting beyond his authority as controller.
sentences.zh: 法律顾问的意思是，确切地说是以书面形式记录下来：如果马克发表这份报告，他可能超出了审计长的职权范围。

sentences.en: And he might get the county sued by a behemoth health network, perhaps, which happens to be the region's largest employer, or by a doctor who was named in the report.
sentences.zh: 并且他可能会让县里遭到一个庞大医疗网络的起诉（该网络恰好是该地区最大的雇主），或者遭到报告中点名的医生的起诉。

sentences.en: Or Mark himself might get sued personally.
sentences.zh: 或者马克本人也可能会面临个人起诉。

sentences.en: And then he'd be on his own.
sentences.zh: 到时候他就得孤立无援地独自面对了。

sentences.en: This was just like, hey, you're going to get us sued.
sentences.zh: 这简直就像是在说，嘿，你会惹得我们被告上法庭。

sentences.en: And you're going to get sued.
sentences.zh: 而且你也会被告。

sentences.en: And maybe other people are going to be sued.
sentences.zh: 说不定其他人也会被告。

sentences.en: That's what this was.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的意思。

sentences.en: And we're telling you in order to scare the shit out of you.
sentences.zh: 我们这么跟你说，就是为了把你吓个半死。

sentences.en: That's what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们在做的事。

sentences.en: It sounds antagonistic.
sentences.zh: 听起来充满敌意。

sentences.en: I would be terrified if I had an attorney and that's...
sentences.zh: 如果我有律师，而这就是……

sentences.en: What they sent you.
sentences.zh: 他们发给你的东西，我会吓坏的。

sentences.en: That's how I knew immediately he's no longer my attorney.
sentences.zh: 这就是我怎么立刻就知道他不再是我的律师了。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Like, as soon as you read this, you're like, they are not going to help me and they are going to throw me under the bus.
sentences.zh: 就像，你一读到这个，就会觉得，他们根本不会帮我，而且他们会把我当成替罪羊抛弃。

sentences.en: Like, you just don't put this kind of stuff in writing unless you're covering your ass.
sentences.zh: 就像，除非是为了推卸责任，否则你绝不会把这种东西写成文字。

sentences.en: I confess, I can halfway see the county's argument here.
sentences.zh: 我承认，我能隐约看出县里的这种论点。

sentences.en: After all,
sentences.zh: 毕竟，

sentences.en: Mark's report, titled,
sentences.zh: 马克的报告题为

sentences.en: The Cost of Misdiagnosis, was actually pretty mushy regarding the county's financial burden due to misdiagnosed child abuse cases.
sentences.zh: 《误诊的代价》，对于因虐童案误诊给县里带来的财务负担，其实写得相当含糊。

sentences.en: He'd calculated it as anywhere from $25,000 to $30,000 a year for each kid in foster care to untold millions of dollars on the high end if the county were to get sued
sentences.zh: 他计算过，寄养儿童每人每年给县里造成的损失从 2.5 万到 3 万美元不等，如果县里遭到家属起诉，

sentences.en: by the families.
sentences.zh: 最高可能会达到数百万美元的惊人数字。

sentences.en: Not exactly conclusive.
sentences.zh: 算不上什么确凿的结论。

sentences.en: And it was true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: He was using the finances as a way to talk about a different, bigger problem.
sentences.zh: 他是在利用财务数据来探讨一个不同且更大的问题。

sentences.en: But he saw nothing wrong with that.
sentences.zh: 但他认为这没什么不对。

sentences.en: He was, in his own words, a bulldog of a controller.
sentences.zh: 用他自己的话说，他是一条咬住不放的斗牛犬式审计长。

sentences.en: He firmly believed he was within his purview.
sentences.zh: 他坚信这完全在自己的职责范围之内。

sentences.en: A week later, two things happened.
sentences.zh: 一周后，发生了两件事。

sentences.en: First,
sentences.zh: 首先，

sentences.en: Mark heard from the county's lawyer again.
sentences.zh: 马克再次收到了县里律师的来信。

sentences.en: He wanted to make sure
sentences.zh: 他想确保

sentences.en: Mark understood that his staff could also be held liable.
sentences.zh: 马克明白他的员工也可能承担法律责任。

sentences.en: Mark was like, noted.
sentences.zh: 马克的反应是：知道了。

sentences.en: And then,
sentences.zh: 然后，

sentences.en: Mark got a separate call from a member of his staff saying someone from the county's finance department had just stopped by.
sentences.zh: 马克接到手下一名员工打来的另一个电话，说县财政部门的人刚来过。

sentences.en: Mark's budget was being cut.
sentences.zh: 马克的预算被削减了。

sentences.en: He would have to lose two employees,
sentences.zh: 他将不得不失去两名员工，

sentences.en: 25% of his staff, effective in four months' time.
sentences.zh: 占其员工总数的 25%，四个月后正式生效。

sentences.en: Mark was appalled.
sentences.zh: 马克震惊不已。

sentences.en: The controller's staff hadn't been cut in years.
sentences.zh: 审计长办公室的预算已经好几年没被削减过了。

sentences.en: This can't be a coincidence, he thought.
sentences.zh: 他想，这绝不可能是巧合。

sentences.en: The next day,
sentences.zh: 第二天，

sentences.en: Mark called his staff into a conference room.
sentences.zh: 马克把员工叫进会议室。

sentences.en: He tried to comfort them as he broke the news.
sentences.zh: 他在宣布这个消息时试图安慰他们。

sentences.en: We're sitting down the next day, my employees, they're learning that their jobs are going to be cut.
sentences.zh: 第二天我们坐在一起，我的员工们得知他们的工作要被裁掉了。

sentences.en: They're learning that they might get sued.
sentences.zh: 他们得知自己可能会被起诉。

sentences.en: And I'm trying to say to them, don't worry.
sentences.zh: 而我则试图对他们说，别担心。

sentences.en: Everything's going to be all right.
sentences.zh: 一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: And they're pretty worried.
sentences.zh: 但他们非常担心。

sentences.en: And I get it, because I'm not not worried either.
sentences.zh: 我能理解，因为我也不是不担心。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: I'm pretty worried.
sentences.zh: 我相当担心。

sentences.en: At this point, were you considering, like, maybe I shouldn't do this?
sentences.zh: 在那个时候，你有没有考虑过，比如，我是不是不该这么做？

sentences.en: Is it worth it?
sentences.zh: 这真的值得吗？

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，会有的。

sentences.en: I didn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 我当时不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: Mark says the meeting was long and heated.
sentences.zh: 马克说那场会议开得很长，气氛也很激烈。

sentences.en: The staff was only eight people total, and they urged him not to publish the report.
sentences.zh: 员工总共只有八人，他们极力劝阻他不要发表报告。

sentences.en: One of them argued, look, if it's our jobs or the report, you got to choose us, right?
sentences.zh: 其中一人争辩道：听着，如果要保住工作还是保住报告，你必须在我们中间做选择，对吧？

sentences.en: But Mark felt like,
sentences.zh: 但马克觉得：

sentences.en: I wasn't elected to protect your jobs.
sentences.zh: 我当选可不是为了保护你们的工作。

sentences.en: Then again, you don't deserve to be booted over this.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，你们也不该为这事被解雇。

sentences.en: Finally, after a couple emotional hours, he conceded, on one condition.
sentences.zh: 最终，在经历了几个小时充满情绪的讨论后，他做出妥协，但有一个条件。

sentences.en: He'd talk to the families, and if they were okay with it, he'd pull the report.
sentences.zh: 他会跟家属谈谈，如果他们没意见，他就撤回报告。

sentences.en: And so that's what he did.
sentences.zh: 于是他真的这么做了。

sentences.en: And so, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，

sentences.en: I then call the solicitor's office of the county, and I say, everything's off.
sentences.zh: 我随后给县法律顾问办公室打电话说，一切都取消了。

sentences.en: We're not going to have the press conference.
sentences.zh: 我们不打算开新闻发布会了。

sentences.en: We're not going to bring the families in.
sentences.zh: 我们不把家属请来了。

sentences.en: Everything.
sentences.zh: 什么都不搞了。

sentences.en: You guys won.
sentences.zh: 你们赢了。

sentences.en: I literally see it say, you guys can pop the champagne.
sentences.zh: 我简直能想象他们说：你们可以开香槟庆祝了。

sentences.en: You won.
sentences.zh: 你们赢了。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: I come in the next day, and I am like, you know, eyes are red, not from being tired, but from being pissed.
sentences.zh: 我第二天去上班时，你知道的，双眼通红，不是因为累，而是因为气愤。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Like, I am just mad.
sentences.zh: 就像，我简直怒火中烧。

sentences.en: And so, I go up to this particular person in the finance department.
sentences.zh: 于是，我走到财政部门的某个特定人员面前。

sentences.en: Mark, it's okay.
sentences.zh: 马克，没关系了。

sentences.en: They put the two positions back.
sentences.zh: 他们把那两个职位加回来了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I expected it.
sentences.zh: 我早就料到了。

sentences.en: You expected it.
sentences.zh: 你料到了。

sentences.en: So, did it confirm in your mind that this was a direct response?
sentences.zh: 所以，这是否在你心里证实了这就是直接的报复？

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: How did you feel?
sentences.zh: 你当时感觉怎么样？

sentences.en: I,
sentences.zh: 我，

sentences.en: I felt two things.
sentences.zh: 我有两种感觉。

sentences.en: Relief.
sentences.zh: 解脱。

sentences.en: I felt relief.
sentences.zh: 我感到一种解脱。

sentences.en: That was probably the biggest feeling I felt because I did not want to screw these two employees.
sentences.zh: 那大概是我感受最深的情绪，因为我不想坑了这两个员工。

sentences.en: And like,
sentences.zh: 而且，

sentences.en: I'm going to have to be mad later.
sentences.zh: 我待会儿还得生气。

sentences.en: Right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: Like, I knew that I was going to be pissed.
sentences.zh: 就像，我知道自己肯定会火冒三丈。

sentences.en: You know, like, I knew like, like this just felt so wrong.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，就像，我觉得这实在是太离谱了。

sentences.en: It felt like I want to take a shower kind of wrong.
sentences.zh: 那种离谱的程度让我直想冲个澡冷静一下。

sentences.en: But I was, I was just relieved.
sentences.zh: 但我当时，我真的只是感到如释重负。

sentences.en: You know, and I,

sentences.en: He read a pre-canned speech that said, hey, I just want to let you know if you guys get reported as child abusers, we have to investigate you.
sentences.zh: 他念了一篇早就准备好的稿子，大意是，嘿，我只是想让你们知道，如果你们被举报虐待儿童，我们就必须调查你们。

sentences.en: You guys get that, right?
sentences.zh: 你们懂的，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, we get it.
sentences.zh: 对，我们懂的。

sentences.en: There wasn't anybody in the audience that was saying, hey, we're upset that we were investigated.
sentences.zh: 台下没有一个人说，嘿，我们对被调查感到很不满。

sentences.en: They were saying we're upset with what the process is going forward.
sentences.zh: 他们说的是，我们对接下来的处理流程感到不满。

sentences.en: I mean, it was a nothing comment.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这根本算不上什么表态。

sentences.en: It had been vetted, obviously, by, sounded to me like it had been vetted by a lawyer.
sentences.zh: 很显然，这稿子是经过审阅的，听起来就像是由律师把关过的。

sentences.en: It was, and it basically said, fuck you to all the families.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，这基本上就是在对所有家庭说：去你妈的。

sentences.en: That's how I felt.
sentences.zh: 我当时就是这种感觉。

sentences.en: And I don't curse very often.
sentences.zh: 而且我平时很少说脏话。

sentences.en: After the meeting, we filed into the hallway, a little stunned.
sentences.zh: 会后，我们走到走廊里，都有点发懵。

sentences.en: The conventional wisdom in child welfare is that lots of child abuse goes unreported.
sentences.zh: 儿童福利领域的传统观念是，许多虐童行为都没有被举报。

sentences.en: Mark and these families were not challenging that wisdom.
sentences.zh: 马克和这些家庭并不是在挑战这种观念。

sentences.en: Instead, they were bringing up a different problem.
sentences.zh: 相反，他们提出了一个不同的问题。

sentences.en: Here in
sentences.zh: 在这里

sentences.en: Pennsylvania's
sentences.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州的

sentences.en: Lehigh Valley, they were describing a crisis of over-reporting, of over-intervention, of false accusation.
sentences.zh: 利哈伊谷，他们描述了一场关于过度举报、过度干预和虚假指控的危机。

sentences.en: For my part, I had never heard of so many families from one small place, all claiming that one health care network had misdiagnosed their kids with disastrous results.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，我从未听说过一个地方有这么多家庭，都声称某家医疗网络误诊了他们的孩子，并导致了灾难性的后果。

sentences.en: Mark's report and his recommendations, they were about investigating and reforming what looked like systemic problems within the hospital and
sentences.zh: 马克的报告和建议，旨在调查和改革医院内部以及

sentences.en: CYS.
sentences.zh: 儿童与青年服务局看似存在的系统性问题。

sentences.en: Which, sure, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，这理所当然。

sentences.en: On the other hand,
sentences.zh: 另一方面，

sentences.en: I'd just heard testimonies by so many people, all mentioning this one doctor, someone they couldn't seem to get through to.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚听取了许多人的证词，他们都提到了同一个医生，一个他们似乎怎么也沟通不通的人。

sentences.en: It was as if we were invisible.
sentences.zh: 就好像我们根本不存在一样。

sentences.en: We had to leave my grandson and could not be around him because of this doctor's uncontested diagnosis.
sentences.zh: 因为这位医生未经反驳的诊断，我们不得不离开孙子，无法陪在他身边。

sentences.en: In this grandmother's story, in all these stories, it sounded as if this doctor had made up her mind and wouldn't budge.
sentences.zh: 在这位祖母的故事里，在所有这些故事里，听起来就像是这位医生已经下定决心，油盐不进。

sentences.en: I ask you, what kind of doctor does this?
sentences.zh: 请问，这算什么医生？

sentences.en: That's what I wanted to know, too.
sentences.zh: 这也是我当时想知道的。
